$Comment: The library's boost token: one item id for a token of any boost. Which boost it starts, by how much, for how long and for which track ride the stack (key ZigBoost), so /zigboost give --player=<name> --boost=<id> hands one of any size, and its tooltip says what it starts. Hold right-click to use it: ZigBoost starts the boost under every limit and the one cap in boost-settings.json, and the token is spent only when the boost starts. Swapping the held item mid-hold cancels the use (OnItemChangeBehavior Cancel), so the spend never lands on another stack. One taken from the creative menu carries no boost and starts nothing. The art is a vanilla potion; point Icon, Model or Texture elsewhere, or override this file by id, to reskin it.
